item.title: Read AI launches an email-based ‘digital twin’ to help you with schedules and answers
item.description: Read AI is launching Ada, which can reply with your availability and extract answers from the company knowledge base and the web.

item.title: Bumble adds AI-powered photo feedback and profile guidance tools
item.description: Bumble and other popular dating apps, like Match Group's Tinder and Hinge, have all embraced AI-powered features.

item.title: Google launches Nano Banana 2 model with faster image generation
item.description: Google is making Nano Banana 2 a default model in Gemini app and in AI mode.

item.title: 2 days left: Lock in the best discounts for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.description: Register now to secure discounts of up to $680 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass. Offer ends tomorrow, February 27, at 11:59 p.m. PT.

item.title: Exhibit in Boston’s startup ecosystem at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
item.description: On June 9, over 1,000 founders, investors, and decision-makers will gather for TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026. This isn’t just foot traffic. It’s a full day of concentrated deal flow.

item.title: Figma partners with OpenAI to bake in support for Codex
item.description: Figma is integrating OpenAI's coding assistant Codex a week after it announced a similar integration with Anthropic's Claude Code.

item.title: Trace raises $3M to solve the AI agent adoption problem in enterprise
item.description: Trace is launching with $3 million in seed funding, including investment from Y Combinator, Zeno Ventures, Transpose Platform Management, Goodwater Capital, Formosa Capital, and WeFunder.

item.title: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff: This isn’t our first SaaSpocalypse
item.description: Salesforce reported a solid year-end earnings and then pulled out all the stops to ward off more talk of the death of its business to AI.

item.title: Gushwork bets on AI search for customer leads — and early results are emerging
item.description: Gushwork has raised $9 million in a seed round led by SIG and Lightspeed. The startup has seen early customer traction from AI search tools like ChatGPT.

item.title: Anthropic acquires computer-use AI startup Vercept after Meta poached one of its founders
item.description: Seattle-based Vercept developed complex agentic tools, including a computer-use agent that could complete tasks inside applications like a person with a laptop would.

item.title: Nvidia has another record quarter amid record capex spends
item.description: "The demand for tokens in the world has gone completely exponential," Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said about the company's earnings.

item.title: The White House wants AI companies to cover rate hikes. Most have already said they would.
item.description: Many hyperscalers have already made public commitments to cover electricity cost increases.

item.title: Alphabet-owned robotics software company Intrinsic joins Google
item.description: Nearly five years after graduating into an independent Alphabet company, Intrinsic is moving under Google's domain.

item.title: Wearable startup CUDIS launches a new health ring line with an AI-fueled ‘coach’
item.description: The wearable incentivizes healthy behavior with points that can be redeemed for health products.

item.title: The public opposition to AI infrastructure is heating up
item.description: Public backlash over the data center boom is leading to a variety of draconian policies — including bans on new construction.

item.title: Gemini can now automate some multi-step tasks on Android
item.description: Gemini on Android will be able to automate tasks involving rideshare requests, or grocery or food delivery, says Google.

item.title: OpenAI COO says ads will be ‘an iterative process’
item.description: COO Brad Lightcap noted that ads can add to the product experience of users if they are done right. He urged to give OpenAI a few months to see how the company fares in rolling out the product.

item.title: OpenClaw creator’s advice to AI builders is to be more playful and allow yourself time to improve
item.description: Peter Steinberger talks about the creation of his viral AI agent OpenClaw and how being more "playful" makes for a better way to learn AI coding.

item.title: Have hard-won scaling lessons to share? Take the stage at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
item.description: Apply to speak at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 by April 17 for a chance to lead a roundtable or breakout session for 1,000 founders and investors. If you’ve built, backed, or operated inside high-growth startups, your experience could shape how the next wave of founders scales.

item.title: About 12% of US teens turn to AI for emotional support or advice
item.description: General-purpose tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok are not designed for this use, making mental health professionals wary.
